periods.time: Seven Stars first and second rounds
periods.label: 深海魔女准备迎击厄运

status.current: wins her D-block first-round match without injury and prepares to face Amane in the third round

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to the point of blunt hostility toward his threats, yet calm and analytical enough to claim she has a countermeasure for Amane.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; she shields him verbally and physically from Amane and worries about his forced double matches.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival/sister-in-law figure; she criticizes Stella's recklessness but later accepts her place in Ikki's path.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Enemy she detests for clinging to Ikki and whose ability she claims she can counter before he reaches Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who tells Ikki Shizuku likely has a real plan against Amane.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Potential D-block competitor removed by Amane's hospital crisis.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Stella's match with mounting frustration, then learns from Ikki's group that Brute Dragon Roar would be extremely dangerous for water/body-based methods. When Amane appears and clings to Ikki, Shizuku kicks him away and states plainly that Ikki finds him disgusting, refusing to let Amane exploit Ikki's kindness. After Kiriko's forced withdrawal and Amane's true ability reveal, Shizuku recognizes the threat but later states she has found a way to defeat Excessive Goddess's Favor. She wins her own D-block first-round match flawlessly, keeping Hagun's perfect first-round record and setting up her confrontation with Amane before Ikki would have to face him.

key_events.summary: Protects Ikki during Amane's reveal and rejects his apology.
Wins her first-round D-block match without injury.
Suspects with Ikki that Amane may have worsened the tournament schedule.
